entry.desc: KELM-specific namelist settings for the KELM build-namelist. KELM_NAMELIST_OPTS is normally set as a compset variable and in general should not be modified for supported compsets. It is recommended that if you want to modify this value for your experiment, you should use your own user-defined component sets via using create_newcase with a compset_file argument.

Dataset name for user-created datasets, used with the ELM_USRDAT grid.
The entry id deliberately keeps ELM's name rather than an KELM-specific one: cime_config/config_grids.xml resolves the ELM_USRDAT domain file as domain.lnd.${ELM_USRDAT_NAME}_navy.nc, and that file is shared across components. Renaming the variable here would mean forking the grid definition. The ELM_USRDAT grid alias itself already matches KELM compsets, since its regex is compset="(DATM|SATM).+ELM" and _KELM_ contains ELM.
Unlike ELM, KELM does not feed this to a -clm_usr_name option -- it has its own build-namelist and resolves fsurdat itself. The only consumer is the domain path above. The default is UNSET, matching ELM.

definitions_variables.help:
========================================= KELM naming conventions ========================================= KELM is the Kokkos port of the E3SM Land Model (ELM). It is selected with the LND compset token KELM, e.g.
2000_DATM%QIA_KELM_SICE_SOCN_SROF_SGLC_SWAV
Note that KELM writes its namelist to lnd_in, the same file name used by ELM, since namelist files are named after the component class.
